dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave parabolic curvature on the trailing edge extending from the apex to the posterior insertion point at the dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate curvature radius at the highest vertical point, lacking acute angularity.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Convex slope approximately 40 degrees relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the torso.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.4:1 ratio of longitudinal base chord length to maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Convex semi-circular arc with a wide radius transitioning smoothly from the blowhole area to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust beak with a thickness-to-length ratio of approximately 0.5 measured from the inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle of approximately 135 degrees at the junction of the melon and the rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible right pectoral fin with a falcate trailing edge and tapered tip.
